Job Description: 
• Expertise in Core Java with knowledge of multithreading, concurrency, memory management and NIO. Should have used concurrent package in detail. 
• Expertise in Enterprise Java or any other server/client architectures with asynchronous or non-blocking request/response 
• Knowledge on secure coding, HTTPS / Secure Hashing Algorithms 
• Working knowledge of JDBC and data modeling. NoSQL desirable. 
• Knowledge of development in Netty would be desirable. 
• Working knowledge of Splunk. 
• Knowledge of Unix. Knowledge on Shell scripting desirable. 
• Knowledge of PL/SQL queries. 

Skill set - Good to know: 
• Spring framework: Basic knowledge of MVC framework 
• Oracle PL/SQL: Has basic knowledge of PL/SQL queries. 
• Unix – simple commands to navigate in a UNIX system.
